summary: Segmented radio group whose selected slab stretches toward the new option on a spring. Form-associated; arrow keys move it.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Comma-separated option labels; empty entries are skipped. Observed: a change rebuilds the buttons and keeps the selection when its label is still there.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected option; must match a label exactly. Falls back to the first option on connect. Observed and reflected; unknown values set later are ignored.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the radio group. Observed.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the options; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the user selects a different option. `value` is the option label. Not fired for changes from code.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Label of the selected option. Setting it writes the `value` attribute; no event fires.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Option labels parsed from the `options` attribute.

keyboard.action: Select and focus the previous or next option, wrapping at the ends.

accessibility: Each option is a native button with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`.
Roving tabindex: only the selected option is in the tab order.
The slab is drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion the slab jumps to the selected option without the spring or wobble, and its texture is drawn once instead of flowing.
form: Submits the selected option label under `name`. No validation. Form reset returns to the option selected on the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset disables the options.
notes: When the selected label contains `ultra` (case-insensitive) the slab uses a faster, brighter pattern.
The element sizes to its options by default; when it is given a larger width, the options share it equally.
